test_cases.name: Task 1 Qualification Gate Nominal Traversal
test_cases.description: Verify contact-free navigation of the ROV through the submerged qualification gate at 1.2m pool depth within the 10-minute trial window.
test_cases.preconditions: Arena pool (20m x 10m) filled to 1.8m depth; qualification gate with 1.0m clear internal width positioned at 1.2m depth; ROV ballasted for neutral buoyancy; ~50m tether connected to surface control station.
test_steps: 1. Deploy the ROV into the designated poolside staging zone and verify surface telemetry link.
2. Command vertical descent to align vehicle centerline with the 1.2m gate passage depth.
3. Apply surge forward thrust to traverse through the 1.0m wide gate aperture.
4. Maintain straight heading until vehicle stern and trailing tether segment completely clear the gate exit plane.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle maintains stable depth at 1.2m ± 0.05m during gate approach.
2. ROV traverses through the 1.0m gate opening with zero physical contact against uprights or crossbar.
3. Trailing tether clears the gate structure without snagging, looping, or displacing gate anchoring buoys.
4. Official judge scorekeeper logs a clean qualification passage on attempt 1.
test_cases.domain: Task 1: Qualification Round Submerged Gate Navigation

test_cases.name: Task 1 Gate Passage Lateral Clearance Boundary (1.00m Gate Opening)
test_cases.description: Validate vehicle clearance boundary when passing through the 1.00m gate opening with minimum lateral margins (<=5cm from uprights).
test_cases.preconditions: Submerged gate measured and calibrated to exactly 1.00m (100.0cm) clear internal width; vehicle width verified at 55cm; pool water still with zero surface turbulence.
test_steps: 1. Position the ROV 2.0m upstream of the 1.00m gate opening, offset laterally 20cm to the starboard upright.
2. Steer the vehicle through the gate with starboard thruster shroud passing within 5cm of the upright.
3. Monitor poolside video feed and underwater acoustic/optical sensors for contact indication.
4. Verify complete passage without deflection or physical touch.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle clears the 1.00m gate opening maintaining >=3cm measured clearance between thruster shroud and upright.
2. Zero physical contact occurs; no vibration or contact marker triggered.
3. Lateral clearance boundary validated as compliant under strict 1.00m aperture constraint.
test_cases.domain: Task 1: Qualification Round Submerged Gate Navigation

test_cases.name: Task 1 Submerged Depth Boundaries at 0.6m Minimum and 1.8m Maximum Limits
test_cases.description: Verify vehicle depth holding and gate navigation at operational depth boundaries: minimum 0.6m shallow limit and maximum 1.8m deep pit.
test_cases.preconditions: Pool depth gradient configured with 0.6m shallow shelf and 1.8m deep pit; hydrostatic depth sensor calibrated with ±0.01m accuracy.
test_steps: 1. Command the ROV to navigate the gate positioned at the shallow boundary depth of 0.60m.
2. Record vertical stability, surface wake, and thruster cavitation risk at 0.60m depth.
3. Relocate gate or transit vehicle to deep boundary pit at 1.80m depth.
4. Execute traversal at 1.80m depth and monitor internal hull pressure and ballast equilibrium.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle navigates gate at 0.60m depth without broaching water surface or cavitating thrusters.
2. Vehicle navigates gate at 1.80m depth without hull seal compression leakage or bottom grounding.
3. Closed-loop depth controller holds target depth within ±0.04m across both 0.6m and 1.8m operational extremes.
test_cases.domain: Task 1: Qualification Round Submerged Gate Navigation

test_cases.name: Task 1 Maximum 3-Attempt Gate Traversal Limit & Timing Penalty Evaluation
test_cases.description: Verify scoring engine and judge protocol when vehicle incurs faults on attempts 1 and 2, and validates success on final attempt 3.
test_cases.preconditions: Judge timing system active; 3-attempt quota initialized for Task 1; stopwatch synchronized.
test_steps: 1. Execute Attempt 1: Intentionally touch gate upright with thruster guard; record fault and abort.
2. Reset vehicle to start gate zone within the 2-minute reset window.
3. Execute Attempt 2: Cause gate abort by tether entanglement; record second fault.
4. Reset and execute Attempt 3: Execute clean contact-free gate passage.
5. Attempt an unauthorized 4th run to verify gate attempt lockout.
expected_results: 1. Judge records navigation faults for Attempt 1 and Attempt 2 with appropriate time penalties.
2. Attempt 3 successfully completes contact-free gate passage and awards qualification points.
3. System rejects 4th attempt; maximum 3-attempt rule enforced strictly.
test_cases.domain: Task 1: Qualification Round Submerged Gate Navigation

test_cases.name: Task 1 Thruster Stall and Gate Upright Collision Recovery
test_cases.description: Verify fault containment and vehicle recovery when port surge thruster stalls during mid-gate passage causing yaw deflection toward upright.
test_cases.preconditions: Vehicle in active forward transit through qualification gate; telemetry monitor logging individual thruster currents.
test_steps: 1. Command 70% forward surge thrust through the gate.
2. Simulate port surge motor stall / mechanical blockage during gate transit.
3. Observe pilot emergency stabilization or autonomous yaw compensation.
4. Apply reverse thrust or emergency stop before severe impact occurs.
5. Extract vehicle safely to poolside staging area for fault inspection.
expected_results: 1. Telemetry detects port motor overcurrent surge and flags thruster stall warning.
2. Vehicle yaw rate remains controllable or failsafe neutral buoyancy prevents violent rotation.
3. Hardened thruster shroud absorbs any incidental brush without hull deformation or gate damage.
4. Pilot initiates safe abort; vehicle is safely recovered without hazard to pool infrastructure.
test_cases.domain: Task 1: Qualification Round Submerged Gate Navigation

test_cases.name: Task 1 50m Tether Trailing Gate Contact & Snag Mitigation
test_cases.description: Verify vehicle tether management and anti-snag behavior when ~50m trailing tether brushes gate uprights.
test_cases.preconditions: 50m umbilical tether deployed from pool deck; tether strain relief collar attached at vehicle stern.
test_steps: 1. Pilot vehicle forward through gate until main hull completely exits gate plane.
2. Introduce tether slack causing trailing umbilical cable to drape over gate lower crossbar.
3. Command slow forward surge thrust to test tether slip across smooth PVC gate surface.
4. If snag occurs, execute pilot tether-jiggle recovery maneuver.
expected_results: 1. Smooth tether jacket slides across PVC gate frame without catching or toppling gate structure.
2. Strain relief prevents mechanical shock to vehicle internal penetrators.
3. Vehicle completes passage without structural tether damage or electrical signal drop.
test_cases.domain: Task 1: Qualification Round Submerged Gate Navigation

test_cases.name: Task 2 Low-Visibility Vision Target Nominal Identification and Soft Contact
test_cases.description: Verify autonomous or vision-guided search, identification, and non-destructive touch of a designated colored balloon in an unlit pool.
test_cases.preconditions: Pool arena lights extinguished (unlit/low-visibility condition); designated target balloon (Red) submerged at 1.0m depth; onboard LED floodlights powered; soft-touch bumper installed.
test_steps: 1. Extinguish arena ambient lighting to simulate low-visibility underwater environment.
2. Activate onboard high-intensity LED illumination array from surface control console.
3. Pilot vehicle in search pattern until camera visual feed captures target balloon.
4. Perform color recognition and align vehicle probe with designated Red balloon target.
5. Advance at low speed (<=0.2 m/s) and make contact with target balloon using soft probe.
6. Hold contact for 3 seconds, then reverse away cleanly.
expected_results: 1. Onboard lighting illuminates target with sufficient contrast for camera sensor recognition.
2. Visual feed confirms Red balloon target locked and centered in reticle.
3. Soft bumper makes physical contact with balloon without rupturing or deflating it.
4. Successful touch verified by judge video review and full Task 2 points awarded.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 2 Ambient Darkness & Onboard Illumination Lux Threshold Boundary
test_cases.description: Validate camera target detection at minimum illumination threshold (<=10 lux ambient darkness with 500 lumen onboard lights).
test_cases.preconditions: Photometer placed at balloon target location; ambient pool water darkness measured at <5 lux; onboard light dimmer calibrated.
test_steps: 1. Set onboard illumination to minimum output (20% power / ~100 lumens).
2. Measure target lux level at 1.5m standoff distance.
3. Incrementally increase illumination power (40%, 60%, 80%, 100%) until color segmentation algorithm reaches >=90% confidence score.
4. Record minimum lux threshold required for positive color identification.
expected_results: 1. Target becomes identifiable at >=50 lux incident illumination at 1.5m standoff distance.
2. Onboard illumination delivers >=200 lux at 1.0m target distance at 80% duty cycle.
3. Color segmentation confidence exceeds 92% meeting low-visibility boundary criteria.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 2 Balloon Color Discrimination Against Clutter and Distractors
test_cases.description: Verify target discrimination when designated color (Green) is placed adjacent to distractor balloons (Red, Blue, Yellow).
test_cases.preconditions: Cluster of 4 colored balloons (Green designated, Red, Blue, Yellow distractors) tethered with 40cm spacing; onboard vision system active.
test_steps: 1. Transmit designated target color 'Green' to pilot and computer vision pipeline.
2. Approach balloon cluster under onboard illumination.
3. Isolate color histograms / bounding boxes for all 4 balloons.
4. Lock onto the designated Green balloon and reject Red, Blue, and Yellow distractors.
5. Execute precision forward touch maneuver exclusively on the Green balloon.
expected_results: 1. Vision algorithm correctly identifies and tags all 4 balloons with respective color classes.
2. Guidance vector navigates directly to Green balloon ignoring adjacent distractors.
3. Probe touches Green balloon without contacting neighboring balloons.
4. Task validated with zero false-target contact penalties.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 2 Soft-Touch Probe Contact Force Boundary Limit (Non-Destructive Touch)
test_cases.description: Validate contact force boundary ensuring touch probe delivers <=2.0 Newtons force upon balloon contact, preventing puncture.
test_cases.preconditions: Calibrated force transducer mounted behind probe bumper; test balloon inflated to standard competition diameter (25cm, 0.05 bar gauge).
test_steps: 1. Drive ROV into target balloon at nominal approach velocity (0.15 m/s).
2. Record peak contact force on transducer during probe impact.
3. Repeat approach at maximum allowable competition velocity (0.35 m/s).
4. Inspect balloon envelope for micro-tears, scuffs, or wall thinning post-contact.
expected_results: 1. Peak contact force remains <=1.8 N at 0.15 m/s and <=2.5 N at 0.35 m/s.
2. Probe compliant spring mechanism absorbs kinetic energy smoothly.
3. Balloon remains fully inflated and undamaged across 5 consecutive touch trials.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 2 Onboard Illumination Electrical Circuit Failure in Unlit Pool
test_cases.description: Verify vehicle emergency holding and surface failsafe response if onboard LED lights fail completely in the unlit pool.
test_cases.preconditions: ROV submerged at 1.5m depth in total darkness pool; light power relay mapped to test trip switch.
test_steps: 1. While navigating in dark pool, trigger onboard LED power bus disconnect.
2. Observe camera video feed blackout on surface console.
3. Verify pilot sensor fallback (depth, heading, IMU attitude telemetry).
4. Command autonomous depth hold or gentle ascent to pool surface.
expected_results: 1. Surface station immediately reports video loss / zero lux illumination fault.
2. Vehicle vertical and heading hold controllers remain stable despite vision loss.
3. Vehicle halts surge motion to avoid collision and ascends safely under pilot command.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 2 False-Positive Target Touch on Wrong-Color Balloon Exception
test_cases.description: Verify scoring engine and judge fault protocol when vehicle touches an incorrect distractor balloon.
test_cases.preconditions: Designated target is Blue; vehicle approaches balloon cluster in low-light condition.
test_steps: 1. Pilot vehicle to intentionally touch adjacent Yellow distractor balloon.
2. Record judge scoring reaction and system fault classification.
3. Verify zero points awarded for the incorrect touch.
4. Re-orient vehicle to locate and touch the correct Blue balloon within remaining time.
expected_results: 1. Judge records touch on non-designated balloon; zero points credited for Task 2 target.
2. System enforces one-touch attempt policy or records fault deduction.
3. Team receives zero points or restarts from staging area per official rules.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 2 Target Balloon Rupture / Excessive Contact Force Penalty
test_cases.description: Verify penalty protocol and abort handling if sharp vehicle protrusion or excessive force bursts the target balloon.
test_cases.preconditions: Arena target balloon tethered in pool; judge acoustic and visual monitoring active.
test_steps: 1. Simulate high-velocity collision or unshielded probe edge contact against balloon.
2. Balloon bursts with acoustic report.
3. Judge signals immediate task abort whistle.
4. Vehicle ordered to surface immediately for bumper safety re-inspection.
expected_results: 1. Judge disqualifies or awards zero score for Task 2 due to damaged arena property.
2. Arena marshal halts competition clock to install replacement balloon.
3. Vehicle barred from subsequent trials until probe compliance is physically re-certified.
test_cases.domain: Task 2: Low-Visibility Vision Target Identification and Touch

test_cases.name: Task 3 Section 1 Straight Path Surge & Heading Hold Traversal
test_cases.description: Verify vehicle hydrodynamic stability and closed-loop heading hold along Section 1 linear PVC channel without wall contact.
test_cases.preconditions: Section 1 PVC maze straight corridor (width 1.2m, length 6.0m) submerged at 1.0m depth; heading gyroscope calibrated.
test_steps: 1. Enter Section 1 entrance gate and establish target heading of 090°.
2. Apply constant 60% surge thrust to traverse the 6.0m straight corridor.
3. Monitor yaw drift, sway oscillations, and wall clearance along both flanks.
4. Exit Section 1 and record transit time and contact count.
expected_results: 1. Heading held within ±2.5° of commanded 090° vector throughout traversal.
2. Lateral distance from corridor walls maintained at >=25cm on port and starboard sides.
3. Zero wall contacts recorded (0 penalty points incurred).
4. Section 1 traversed cleanly in <25 seconds.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 Section 2 Obstacle Course Pylon Avoidance and Yaw Maneuvering
test_cases.description: Verify precise 90° turns and sway maneuvering around staggered submerged obstacle pylons in Section 2.
test_cases.preconditions: Section 2 contains 3 staggered vertical PVC obstacle pylons spaced 1.5m apart; camera and telemetry active.
test_steps: 1. Enter Section 2 obstacle zone from Section 1 exit.
2. Execute starboard yaw rotation to negotiate around Pylon 1.
3. Apply port sway thrust and forward surge to clear Pylon 2.
4. Re-align vehicle heading to round Pylon 3 and enter Section 3 transition corridor.
5. Manage tether payout to avoid wrapping cable around obstacle pylons.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle completes slalom trajectory around all 3 pylons with >=15cm minimum clearance.
2. Multi-DoF thruster coordination enables tight turning radius without wall brushing.
3. Tether handler maintains proper tension, preventing line snagging around pylons.
4. Section 2 completed with zero obstacle contacts.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 Section 3 1.5m High-Wall Narrow Channel Submerged Traversal
test_cases.description: Verify depth control and spatial containment in Section 3 bounded by 1.5m high vertical PVC walls.
test_cases.preconditions: Section 3 channel bounded by 1.5m vertical PVC walls; channel internal width 1.1m; top of wall at 0.3m depth, bottom at 1.8m.
test_steps: 1. Submerge vehicle to 1.1m depth (midpoint of 1.5m high wall vertical span).
2. Enter Section 3 narrow channel and activate active depth hold.
3. Traverse the 5.0m walled channel while monitoring pitch, roll, and heave stability.
4. Exit through the final maze portal into the recovery arena.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle operates within the 1.5m vertical wall envelope without broaching or bottom grounding.
2. Depth maintained at 1.1m ± 0.08m throughout channel navigation.
3. Narrow 1.1m channel negotiated with zero wall collisions.
4. Full base points for Section 3 completion earned.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 Maze Wall Collision Penalty Deduction Boundary (<=5 Points per Contact)
test_cases.description: Validate judge scoring logic and deduction thresholds when vehicle registers 1, 3, and 5 separate wall contacts.
test_cases.preconditions: Scoring sheet calibrated with <=5.0 points deduction per verified physical contact; maze acoustic/video judges ready.
test_steps: 1. Traverse maze; execute Run A with exactly 1 deliberate wall brush.
2. Verify judge records exactly 1 contact and deducts 5.0 points from base task score.
3. Execute Run B with exactly 3 wall brushes; verify deduction equals 15.0 points.
4. Execute Run C with 6 contacts; verify deduction equals 30.0 points or triggers task score floor at zero.
expected_results: 1. Run A: Task score = Base Points - 5.0 points.
2. Run B: Task score = Base Points - 15.0 points.
3. Run C: Task score deductions cannot reduce task total below 0 points.
4. Collision penalty calculation confirmed compliant with official rules.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 Section 3 Submerged Containment Boundary (Depth Hold vs Broaching)
test_cases.description: Verify vehicle vertical boundary hold ensuring vehicle roof remains >=10cm below the 1.5m wall top (depth <0.4m forbidden).
test_cases.preconditions: Section 3 wall top submerged at 0.30m below water surface; boundary depth alarm set at 0.40m.
test_steps: 1. Pilot vehicle along Section 3 at 0.60m depth.
2. Gradually ascend toward wall top: test 0.50m, 0.45m, and 0.41m depths.
3. Verify depth alarm triggers if vehicle ascends shallower than 0.40m boundary limit.
4. Ensure vehicle never broaches or clears wall top from above.
expected_results: 1. Telemetry triggers visual warning when vehicle depth reaches 0.40m boundary.
2. Pilot or autonomous override stops ascent, maintaining submerged channel containment.
3. Vehicle completes traversal without broaching surface or traversing over wall tops.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 Surface Broaching Disqualification in High-Walled Passage
test_cases.description: Verify disqualification / run void protocol if vehicle broaches water surface to bypass 1.5m maze walls from above.
test_cases.preconditions: Vehicle navigating Section 3 high-walled channel; official judge observing surface profile.
test_steps: 1. Intentionally blow ballast or command full vertical thruster ascent.
2. Propel vehicle over the top edge of the 1.5m PVC wall, surfacing into clear air.
3. Observe judge whistle and immediate run abort command.
4. Verify official scorecard records Disqualification / Void for Task 3.
expected_results: 1. Judge identifies out-of-bounds violation: vehicle broached above 1.5m wall containment.
2. Run aborted immediately; zero points awarded for Section 3.
3. Protocol enforces requirement that vehicle must navigate through, not over, the maze.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 Dead-End Entrapment and Reverse Yaw Extraction
test_cases.description: Verify pilot recovery and reverse maneuvering when vehicle enters a maze dead-end corridor.
test_cases.preconditions: Maze configured with a 2.0m blind dead-end pocket branching off Section 2; vehicle inside dead-end.
test_steps: 1. Steer vehicle into the blind dead-end corridor until forward bulkhead is 20cm from end wall.
2. Evaluate spatial options: pilot attempts 180° pirouette yaw turn in 1.2m width.
3. If turn radius insufficient, engage reverse surge thrusters with stern camera / sonar assistance.
4. Reverse vehicle cleanly back into main channel and re-orient onto correct course.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle executes reverse exit without wedging against corner junctions.
2. Tether does not foul under vehicle belly or thruster nozzles during reverse motion.
3. Vehicle re-enters main course and completes maze run within allowable overall time window.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Task 3 50m Tether Snag on Obstacle Pylon in Section 2
test_cases.description: Verify vehicle tether snag detection and counter-yaw unwrapping maneuver around obstacle pylon.
test_cases.preconditions: 50m umbilical tether snagged on Pylon 2; pilot observes sudden vehicle arrest and tether tension spike.
test_steps: 1. Vehicle moves past Pylon 2; tether catches on pylon bracket.
2. Surface console logs motor current spike due to forward motion impedance.
3. Pilot stops forward thrust, checks rear camera view, and identifies snag location.
4. Pilot executes reverse yaw rotation matching the snag loop to unwrap cable.
5. Deck crew takes in slack to clear the pylon.
expected_results: 1. Snag detected before cable insulation tears or penetrator is damaged.
2. Counter-rotation successfully releases tether loop from pylon.
3. Forward motion resumes without needing poolside diver intervention.
test_cases.domain: Task 3: The Maze Walk Submerged Traversal

test_cases.name: Physical Constraint: Maximum Vehicle Weight Boundary (35.00kg Pass vs 35.05kg DQ)
test_cases.description: Validate pre-event compliance inspection weighing on calibrated crane scale at strict 35.00kg threshold.
test_cases.preconditions: Certified digital hanging scale calibrated with ±0.01kg accuracy; vehicle fully assembled with battery, camera, and ballast.
test_steps: 1. Suspend vehicle on calibrated scale with dry tether connector; record mass reading for Vehicle A at exactly 35.00kg.
2. Verify inspection official issues approved compliance stamp for 35.00kg.
3. Add 50 grams of ballast to create Vehicle B weighing exactly 35.05kg.
4. Record official verdict on 35.05kg reading.
5. Strip non-essential mass to return vehicle to <=35.00kg and verify re-test clearance.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle A (35.00 kg) validated as PASS (inclusive threshold: <=35.0 kg).
2. Vehicle B (35.05 kg) validated as FAIL / Disqualification (strictly exceeds 35.0 kg limit).
3. Re-weighed vehicle approved only when certified scale displays <=35.00 kg.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Physical Constraint: Lightweight Bonus Tier Boundary (<20.00kg vs 20.00kg)
test_cases.description: Verify scoring engine lightweight bonus tier threshold (<20.00kg strict inequality rule).
test_cases.preconditions: Calibrated inspection scale; scoring bonus matrix programmed per Section 6.
test_steps: 1. Weigh Vehicle 1: Measured mass = 19.95kg. Submit to scorecard.
2. Weigh Vehicle 2: Measured mass = 20.00kg. Submit to scorecard.
3. Weigh Vehicle 3: Measured mass = 25.00kg. Submit to scorecard.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle 1 (19.95kg) receives maximum Lightweight Bonus Tier points (mass < 20.00kg).
2. Vehicle 2 (20.00kg) enters standard weight tier; receives 0 bonus points for strict <20.0kg tier.
3. Vehicle 3 (25.00kg) approved to compete with 0 weight bonus.
4. Strict inequality boundary (<20.00kg) verified.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Physical Constraint: Compact Footprint Bonus Envelope Verification (L<75, B<65.01, H<60.01 cm)
test_cases.description: Validate physical dimensional gauge test for compact footprint bonus points.
test_cases.preconditions: Dimensional check cube template (75.0cm x 65.01cm x 60.01cm); calibrated laser distance meter.
test_steps: 1. Measure Vehicle 1: Length=74.5cm, Breadth=64.8cm, Height=59.5cm; slide through gauge template.
2. Measure Vehicle 2: Length=75.0cm, Breadth=65.0cm, Height=59.5cm; test against template.
3. Measure Vehicle 3: Length=74.0cm, Breadth=65.02cm, Height=59.0cm; test against template.
expected_results: 1. Vehicle 1 fits completely inside dimensional cube without forcing; earns Compact Footprint Bonus.
2. Vehicle 2 fails bonus: Length 75.0cm does not satisfy strict L < 75.0cm requirement.
3. Vehicle 3 fails bonus: Breadth 65.02cm exceeds 65.01cm ceiling.
4. Dimensional envelope boundary rules rigorously enforced.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Safety Constraint: External Hardware Kill Switch Actuation Latency (<100ms Cutoff)
test_cases.description: Verify emergency kill switch shuts down all thrusters and actuators within <100ms of physical actuation.
test_cases.preconditions: Vehicle secured on dry bench in water test tank; all thrusters commanded to 100% duty cycle; high-speed digital oscilloscope connected to motor ESC PWM/power rails.
test_steps: 1. Spin up all thrusters to 100% full forward/reverse speed.
2. Actuate prominent external mechanical kill switch (red mushroom e-stop button).
3. Record elapsed time from switch contact closure to total thruster power bus cutoff on oscilloscope.
4. Verify zero residual motor rotation within 150ms.
expected_results: 1. Actuator power bus disconnected in <80ms (strict compliance with <100ms requirement).
2. All thruster spinning halts immediately.
3. Auxiliary systems (grippers, pneumatics) safely de-energize.
4. Kill switch verified as hardwired and failsafe.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Safety Constraint: Kill Switch Latching Relay Failure / Actuator Runaway Exception
test_cases.description: Verify failure mode behavior if emergency kill switch mechanical latch or control relay welds closed under high inductive load.
test_cases.preconditions: Vehicle on test bench; simulated welded relay contact on ESC power branch.
test_steps: 1. Simulate welded contact on main relay while thrusters are commanded to spin.
2. Actuate external kill switch.
3. Detect that primary relay failed to open.
4. Verify secondary inline circuit breaker / surface tether isolation switch cuts power.
expected_results: 1. Secondary surface circuit breaker trips immediately upon manual deck throw, isolating vehicle.
2. Pre-event safety inspection flags relay failure; vehicle rejected until contactor is replaced.
3. Redundant dual-layer power cutoff prevents hazardous runaway in pool.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Electrical Constraint: Branch Fusing on 230V AC Supply and DC Motor ESC Rails
test_cases.description: Verify electrical protection compliance: dedicated fast-acting fuses on 230V AC utility surface line and individual DC motor rails.
test_cases.preconditions: Electrical distribution schematic inspected; multimeter and circuit tester available; vehicle open for bench audit.
test_steps: 1. Inspect surface power supply: verify 230V / 50Hz AC input is protected with 16A fast-blow circuit breaker.
2. Inspect DC distribution board inside pressure hull: verify each ESC motor rail has a dedicated inline fuse (e.g. 20A ATO/ATC).
3. Inspect logic board / camera rail: verify 5V/12V DC-DC converters have dedicated 2A fuse protection.
4. Verify reverse polarity protection diodes / MOSFETs on main battery terminal.
expected_results: 1. Surface 230V AC power protected with rated fuse/breaker meeting IEC 60898.
2. Every motor branch individually fused; zero unfused power branches detected.
3. Reverse polarity protection prevents damage if leads are reversed.
4. Electrical safety audit marked PASS.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Electrical Constraint: Motor ESC Overcurrent Short-Circuit and Fuse Trip Exception
test_cases.description: Verify branch fuse safely blows and isolates short-circuited motor branch without collateral hull damage or fire.
test_cases.preconditions: Vehicle bench test fixture; port surge motor ESC wired with calibrated 20A fast-acting fuse; artificial short-circuit simulator.
test_steps: 1. Apply 40A overcurrent surge to port motor branch simulating fouled propeller stall.
2. Measure time-to-clear for the 20A branch fuse.
3. Verify faulted branch is completely de-energized.
4. Verify adjacent starboard motor, logic computer, and camera feeds remain fully powered and operational.
expected_results: 1. 20A fuse safely blows within <20ms, isolating faulted motor rail.
2. Zero smoke, thermal damage, or PCB trace delamination occurs inside pressure housing.
3. Main DC bus voltage remains stable (no brownout on telemetry or camera).
4. Short-circuit containment verified compliant with competition safety rules.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Safety Constraint: Pneumatic Auxiliary System Pressure Limit (<=6.0 bar Ceiling)
test_cases.description: Validate pneumatic gas accumulator pressure regulation ensuring operating pressure never exceeds 6.0 bar (600 kPa).
test_cases.preconditions: Calibrated pneumatic pressure gauge; vehicle equipped with pneumatic gripper or ballast accumulator.
test_steps: 1. Connect compressed air supply to vehicle onboard pneumatic reservoir.
2. Pressurize system to standard operating pressure of 4.5 bar; verify zero pressure drop over 15 minutes.
3. Incrementally pressurize to 5.8 bar and 6.0 bar; monitor pressure regulator stability.
4. Attempt to pressurize to 6.2 bar; verify pressure relief valve opens.
expected_results: 1. Normal operating pressure maintained at <=5.0 bar.
2. Mechanical pressure relief valve cracks open at 6.0 bar ± 0.1 bar, venting excess gas.
3. Reservoir pressure cannot exceed 6.0 bar under any input condition.
4. Safety inspection approves pneumatic system.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Safety Constraint: Pneumatic Regulator Overpressure Relief Valve Trip (>6.0 bar) Exception
test_cases.description: Verify safety relief valve response if upstream pneumatic regulator fails fully open.
test_cases.preconditions: Pneumatic test bench with safety enclosure; regulator bypass valve installed.
test_steps: 1. Simulate upstream pressure regulator failure by opening high-pressure bypass from dive tank.
2. Monitor downstream accumulator pressure spike.
3. Verify relief valve vents gas rapidly into pool water.
4. Measure peak pressure achieved during full bypass dump.
expected_results: 1. Relief valve opens instantly, venting gas and preventing vessel rupture.
2. Peak system pressure clamped below 6.2 bar.
3. Pressure vessel integrity maintained with zero catastrophic failure.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Environmental Safety: Zero Environmental Chemical/Oil Leakage Strict Containment
test_cases.description: Verify zero leakage of oils, lubricants, battery electrolytes, or hazardous chemicals into pool water.
test_cases.preconditions: Clean water test tank; white absorbent inspection paper; UV blacklight for fluorescent oil detection.
test_steps: 1. Submerge vehicle in clear test tank for 30 minutes with thrusters cycling through forward and reverse speeds.
2. Wipe water surface along vehicle perimeter with clean white oil-absorbent paper.
3. Inspect water surface under UV blacklight for petroleum or synthetic sheen.
4. Inspect battery enclosure for acidic/alkaline electrolyte seepage using litmus test strips.
expected_results: 1. Zero oil sheen, droplets, or particulate dispersion detected on water surface.
2. Absorbent paper shows zero discoloration or hydrocarbon residue.
3. Litmus test confirms neutral pH (no battery chemical leakage).
4. Environmental compliance certified for competition pool entry.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Environmental Safety: Propeller Shaft Dynamic Seal Oil Drip & Run Abort Exception
test_cases.description: Verify emergency abort and environmental containment protocol if a propeller shaft seal leaks oil into the pool.
test_cases.preconditions: Vehicle in competition arena; simulated oil release marker deployed.
test_steps: 1. Release trace biodegradable test fluorescent marker at propeller shaft during mission run.
2. Arena marshal detects sheen on pool surface and sounds immediate abort whistle.
3. Vehicle pilot immediately shuts down all thrusters via kill switch.
4. Poolside rescue team deploys oil absorbent boom and retrieves vehicle.
expected_results: 1. Mission terminated immediately upon environmental sheen detection.
2. Vehicle disqualified from current round per Section 7 zero-leakage mandate.
3. Vehicle barred from water until shaft seals are replaced and re-inspected.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Optical Safety: Class 2 Laser Boundary Rating (<1 mW Cutoff)
test_cases.description: Verify optical power and alignment of laser scaling/aiming aids ensuring rating does not exceed Class 2 (<1 mW) and orientation is away from human eyes.
test_cases.preconditions: Calibrated optical power meter (spectroradiometer) at 532nm/650nm; vehicle laser diodes powered.
test_steps: 1. Measure optical power output of onboard parallel scaling lasers at 10cm aperture.
2. Verify laser power reading is <=0.95 mW (Class 2 limit < 1.0 mW).
3. Verify laser beam orientation is fixed strictly parallel to camera optical axis facing forward/downward.
4. Verify physical beam shroud prevents upward stray reflections toward spectator gallery.
expected_results: 1. Laser optical output measured at <1.0 mW meeting Class 2 safety standards (IEC 60825-1).
2. Beam alignment certified downward/forward away from judges and spectators.
3. Class 2 laser safety label affixed to vehicle hull.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Safety Constraint: Certified Lithium Battery Pack Regulatory Documentation Audit
test_cases.description: Verify onboard lithium battery packs have valid UN 38.3 transport certification, CE/UL safety certification, and active Battery Management System (BMS).
test_cases.preconditions: Technical documentation binder presented at Stage 4 VALIDATE gate; battery pack physically extracted for inspection.
test_steps: 1. Review battery specification sheet: verify cell chemistry (LiFePO4 or certified Li-ion 18650/21700).
2. Check UN 38.3 test summary document and CE/UL compliance certificates.
3. Inspect physical battery pack: verify integrated BMS with overvoltage, undervoltage, and thermal cutoff protection.
4. Inspect fireproof battery containment bag/vessel.
expected_results: 1. Valid UN 38.3 and manufacturer certificates verified and stamped by safety official.
2. Integrated BMS confirmed functional on all series cell groups.
3. Battery approved for competition pool operation.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints

test_cases.name: Structural Constraint: Hydrostatic Pressure Hull Seal Boundary at 1.8m Pool Pit
test_cases.description: Verify watertight integrity of main electronic enclosure seals under maximum hydrostatic pressure at 1.8m pool depth.
test_cases.preconditions: Pool deep pit at 1.8m depth (hydrostatic pressure 0.18 bar gauge / ~118 kPa absolute); internal vacuum test kit or humidity telemetry sensor active.
test_steps: 1. Submerge vehicle to maximum pool depth of 1.80m for a continuous 20-minute soak period.
2. Monitor internal relative humidity and pressure telemetry via surface telemetry stream.
3. Cycle vertical thrusters to create dynamic pressure fluctuations around end-cap O-rings.
4. Retrieve vehicle and conduct internal visual inspection for droplet condensation.
expected_results: 1. Internal hull humidity remains constant (zero water ingress over 20-minute submersion).
2. O-ring seals withstand 0.18 bar static and dynamic head pressure without deformation.
3. Electronics enclosure interior remains 100% dry; pressure seal boundary verified.
test_cases.domain: Physical & Safety Constraints
